This editorial illustration depicts two men from the waist up, positioned side-by-side against a blurred architectural backdrop. Both men wear white shirts and blue denim overalls with visible metal buckles and straps. The man on the left has light skin, dark hair, and a round face. The man on the right wears rectangular glasses, has a more angular face, and holds a wooden handle attached to a flat metal tool, similar to a hoe or shovel, which rests near his shoulder.

A large red word "TEMPO" dominates the upper center, with "50 Tahun!" written in red script below it. Centered at the bottom, large black block letters read "MAIN-MAIN LUMBUNG PANGAN" above a paragraph of smaller black text. The word "INVESTIGASI" is placed above these words, with a red "T" integrated into the letters. Additional text at the top includes "SIASAT KEDUA FIRLI BAHURI" and "BATAL MELEBUR ASURANSI APARAT". The bottom right features a date "11-17 OKTOBER 2021", a price "RP 45.000", a QR code, and a barcode. The background shows a weathered, gabled wooden structure and bare tree branches.
